items.rationale: Nothing persists between sessions unless the program saves and reloads it. A larger window only changes how much fits in one call (M7). Automatic memory or compaction of past sessions is not something the model does (M3).

Retrieval puts only the relevant chunks in context, so each call stays short. Pasting everything in (b) makes every call pay for all the manuals; the model has no memory between calls to rely on (d); skipping the manuals (c) loses grounding.

items.answer: The context has grown, so each call sends and processes a longer input.

items.rationale: Each call carries the setup plus all earlier messages and tool results, so input tokens rise with every step. Saying the model gets slower or tools cost more misses this.
A small per-student fact must be saved outside the window and loaded in the next session. The window is gone after the session (b, c); the manuals do not contain student status (a).

items.rationale: Chunks cut from a document lose context such as which machine they describe; adding a short explanation or the machine name to each chunk (contextual retrieval) fixes it. Partial: filtering by machine metadata is also reasonable.
